messages:
anna.policies: Not sure if you saw: customer reported a missing audit entry for a BYOK import in prod yesterday. They provided an S3 log slice that shows the wrapped_key upload but no operator_witness event. Can we triage?
logbot: Ingested logs: s3://redwood-logs/prod/hsm/2026/03/20/ingest-01-abc.tar.gz (sha256: e3b0c442).
kevin.privsec: That sounds like an audit gap. First question: was RBAC change deployed around that time? Any recent policy rollouts?
anna.policies: We did a short-lived RBAC tweak to let platform-ops group call proxy-side import for a migration last week. Policy: allow group:platform-ops -> POST /hsm/import-session for resource:staging/prod-proxy. Rollback was scheduled but may not have completed.
ops-bot: Policy change: PR #5198 merged by anna.policies at 2026-03-19T22:10Z. Rollback failed: job rollback/rbac-rollback-5198 errored at 2026-03-20T02:17Z.
tom.runtime: If the policy expansion bypassed operator_witness middleware, that could explain missing operator events. Need to check sidecar vs proxy code paths.
kevin.privsec: Can we get the exact request IDs for the customer's import call? Ask them for the X-Request-Id headers.
liz.compliance: Customer already provided one: X-Request-Id: cx-22b7f3. They also want SOC2 evidence. We'll need timeline, log slices, PRs, and the mitigation plan.
anna.policies: Pulling logs for cx-22b7f3 now. logbot: query results: request.id=cx-22b7f3 -> ingress: 2026-03-20T03:02:13Z, service=proxy-v1, status=200, operator_witness_id=null, auth.principal=svc-platform-migration.
kevin.privsec: auth.principal=svc-platform-migration is in platform-ops. That suggests RBAC allowed the call without operator witness check. Need to confirm whether middleware checks principal group membership.
tom.runtime: Code note: middleware checks header X-Operator-Witness unless principal is in allowlist for automated imports. Looks like platform-ops was added to allowlist in PR #5198.
anna.policies: PR #5198 diff excerpt: `allowlist: ["svc-platform-migration"] # temporary` and `skip_operator_witness: true`. Oops. That was supposed to be scoped to staging only.
liz.compliance: Typo in participant name; correction: liz.compliance: We'll need a full audit pack: (1) PRs (#5198, #5202 rollback), (2) log slice s3://redwood-logs/prod/hsm/2026/03/20/cx-22b7f3.json, (3) timeline of actions, (4) mitigation evidence.
ops-bot: Rollback job #5202 completed at 2026-03-21T06:41Z. But customer call at 2026-03-20T03:02:13Z predates rollback.
kevin.privsec: Immediate mitigation: rotate operator tokens used by platform-ops and set a short RBAC freeze for import endpoints until we add authorization checks that require operator_witness AND matching principal attributes (tenant_id, request_nonce).
tom.runtime: I'll add a runtime check: even if principal is allowlisted, require operator_witness_id != null for prod. Push patch behind feature flag.
anna.policies: I'll open a policy audit ticket and revert any unintended allowlist entries. Ticket SEC-1602 created.
liz.compliance: Also file an incident report for the customer with planned remediation and ETA. They need confirmation that key material was not exported.
ops-bot: Forensics: no egress events to external IPs correlated with cx-22b7f3. Data plane shows operation completed but wrapped_key never left HSM boundary.
kevin.privsec: Good. Still a gap in auditability is a compliance finding. We need to: (1) create replayable reproducible test, (2) add end-to-end integration test to prevent future allowlist drift, (3) prepare SOC2 bridge letter.
anna.policies: Repro plan: create svc-platform-migration token in staging, apply PR changes, run curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://proxy.prod.redwood.internal/hsm/import-session -d '{"wrapped_key":"..."}' -H "X-Request-Id: test-allowlist"` and assert audit contains operator_witness.
logbot: Saved repro logs to s3://redwood-tests/forensics/sec-1602/repro-2026-03-21.tar.gz
kevin.privsec: For mitigation timeline: (A) rotate tokens now (done?), (B) enforce operator_witness for prod (in progress), (C) create backfill audit markers for affected window (script to annotate logs) and store in secure bucket: s3://redwood-logs/forensics/SEC-1602/annotations.jsonl
anna.policies: I rotated tokens at 2026-03-21T07:05Z and removed platform-ops allowlist. Patch PR opened for runtime check.
liz.compliance: Please include a statement on retention: keep the original raw logs and annotated logs for 1 year and export a copy to the SOC2 evidence bucket s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/SEC-1602/.
tom.runtime: Deploy plan: feature-flagged check -> rollout to canary -> red-team verification -> prod rollout. ETA 24h.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary at 2026-03-21T12:00Z, prod tentative 2026-03-22T02:00Z pending sign-off.
kevin.privsec: Postmortem owners: anna.policies (policy side), tom.runtime (runtime), kevin.privsec (security), liz.compliance (compliance). Meeting scheduled 2026-03-21T09:00Z.
anna.policies: Customer notified with initial incident summary and we asked for any additional request IDs. They acknowledged and want SOC2 evidence pack once ready.
logbot: Evidence URIs appended: s3://redwood-logs/prod/hsm/2026/03/20/cx-22b7f3.json, s3://redwood-logs/forensics/SEC-1602/annotations.jsonl, s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/SEC-1602/pack-2026-03-21.zip
kevin.privsec: Closing loop: after prod rollout, schedule a compliance review to ensure RBAC changes require an approver and a canary window. Also add immutable audit markers whenever skip_operator_witness is used.
liz.compliance: I'll draft the SOC2 bridge note and include the artifact URIs. Will attach the PM timeline and PR links in the evidence pack.
anna.policies: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread updated with final evidence pack link and postmortem doc.
